generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, Satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value i.e 10.46 Lakhs), as prime contractor, at least one Similar Work

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, Executed minimum quantities as 1. Painting works 1372.00 Sqm, 2. Tiling works 50.00 Sqm, 3. Fabrication work 2637.00 Kgs and 4. Plastering works 144.00 Sqm.

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 20.92 lakhs (usually not less than the estimated cost under this contract and Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents)
